title: You can have it all: How the interplay between SnRK1 and RBOH1 promotes nitrate uptake in tomato
content: In the modern world, everything seems to be geared toward optimization. “Higher, faster, further” has become the dominant mindset, although you should ask yourself from time to time whether this is really the right way to go. Nevertheless, for some organisms, optimization is a must. Plants, for example, need to optimize the uptake of essential nutrients from the soil to ensure their healthy growth, adaptation to various stresses, and their reproductive success.
